raw: [{"bbox": [85, 74, 583, 90], "category": "Page-header", "text": "KHANG DIEN HOUSE TRADING AND INVESTMENT JOINT STOCK COMPANY"}, {"bbox": [562, 99, 688, 114], "category": "Page-header", "text": "Form B 09 - DN/HN"}, {"bbox": [85, 131, 555, 148], "category": "Section-header", "text": "## 2 SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES (continued)"}, {"bbox": [85, 164, 281, 181], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.7 Inventories (continued)"}, {"bbox": [129, 197, 243, 212], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### Other inventories"}, {"bbox": [129, 229, 688, 261], "category": "Text", "text": "Inventories including raw materials are stated at the lower of costs incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition and net realisable value."}, {"bbox": [129, 278, 688, 310], "category": "Text", "text": "Net realisable value is the estimated selling price in the normal course of business, less the estimated costs of completion and the estimated selling expenses."}, {"bbox": [129, 326, 688, 358], "category": "Text", "text": "The Group applies the perpetual method system for inventories. Cost is determined by the weighted average method."}, {"bbox": [129, 375, 412, 390], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### Provision for decline in value of inventories"}, {"bbox": [129, 407, 688, 455], "category": "Text", "text": "Provision is made when necessary, for obsolete, slow-moving and defective inventory items. The difference between the provision of this year and the provision of the previous year is recognised as an increase or decrease of cost of goods sold in the year."}, {"bbox": [85, 471, 210, 486], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.8 Investments"}, {"bbox": [129, 499, 315, 515], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### Investments held to maturity"}, {"bbox": [129, 527, 688, 558], "category": "Text", "text": "Investments held to maturity are investments which the Group has a positive intention and ability to hold until maturity."}, {"bbox": [129, 570, 688, 629], "category": "Text", "text": "Investments held to maturity include term deposits and others held to maturity. Those investments are initially accounted for at cost. Subsequently, the Board of Management reviews all outstanding investments to determine the amount of provision to be recognised at the year end."}, {"bbox": [129, 642, 688, 714], "category": "Text", "text": "Provision for diminution in value of investments held to maturity is made when there is evidence that the investment is uncollectible in whole or in part. Changes in the provision balance during the accounting year are recorded as an increase or decrease in financial expenses. A reversal, if any, is made only to the extent the investment is restored to its original cost."}, {"bbox": [129, 727, 688, 772], "category": "Text", "text": "Investments held to maturity are classified into short-term and long-term investments held to maturity on the consolidated balance sheet based on the remaining period from the consolidated balance sheet date to the maturity date."}, {"bbox": [380, 981, 395, 994], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "16"}]
